exact_blockers.requirement: Provide an exact deployable local VoiceFilter-Lite/personal-VAD checkpoint and runtime artifact with immutable hashes, byte counts, and provenance.
Provide a rights-cleared enrolled-speaker cohort with overlapping speakers and clean target references for fair extraction scoring.
Clear source/checkpoint/data rights, notices, redistribution, product-use, and publication terms before any claim.
Provide an isolated pinned runtime with deterministic execution recipe and recorded platform for the exact candidate.
Reproduce an approved exact-runtime reference on frozen inputs with hashed outputs and parity/tolerance verification.
Verify task geometry, enrollment/reference conditioning, sample-time mapping, delay, reset/state isolation, and invalid-input handling.
Keep any future SDK adapter optional, caller-supplied-asset, off by default, and outside installed v0/shared build/CI/public registration.
Record explicit default-selection, resource/deadline, release, and public-benchmark approval; missing evidence cannot qualify.

gates.requirement: Exact VoiceFilter-Lite/personal-VAD source revision, checkpoint/runtime assets, hashes, byte counts, and immutable manifests are pinned and present.
Acquisition, local evaluation, publication, redistribution, product-use, and derivative-output rights are cleared with complete notices.
An approved exact-runtime reference reproduces the candidate on frozen inputs with hashed outputs and verified parity/tolerance policy.
A rights-cleared held-out cohort with enrollment, overlapping speakers, clean target references, and task-matched spatial/TSE scoring is present.
An isolated pinned runtime and deterministic command recipe reproduce outputs without network or hidden mutation.
Geometry, channel/rate/hop, timestamp calibration, delay, reset/state isolation, and content/availability mapping are verified.
Any future SDK adapter is optional, caller-supplied-asset, preserves installed v0 behavior, and is not registered/enabled by default.
Explicit default-selection, resource/deadline evidence, and release/public-benchmark approval are recorded; default remains off.

qualification.reason: No deployable local VoiceFilter-Lite/personal-VAD checkpoint, exact runtime, rights record, enrolled-speaker target cohort, or approved parity evidence is present.
